Puzzle Labyrinth is a game where the player must solve puzzles and find items to open doors that lead to the exit of a maze.

With 60 stages filled with traps and monsters getting in the way, it is sure to keep players entertained till the last minute of their escape...if they ever manage to.

152966.overview:
Puyo Puyo Chronicleis a game for the Nintendo 3DS as part of a celebration of Puyo Puyo's 25th Anniversary. Barring spinoffs, this is first Puyo game to be presented with 3D characters as opposed to 2D portraits.
transported to. However, before Arle could admonish him, Satan tells her to head for the tower before he gets spirited away.

Puyo Puyo Chronicle, similar to past anniversary titles Puyo Puyo! 15th Anniversary and Puyo Puyo!! 20th Anniversary features multiple options for multiplayer both for local and online play, which includes the return of the Tsu and Fever rules. However unlike the past anniversary titles, it contains a new RPG mode. This RPG mode has players take on the role of Arle and Carbuncle as you're tasked with finding a way back home, with the assistance of a new character named Ally. This mode contains battles against monsters where players play Puyo Puyo in order to inflict damage, and a level up system where stats like defense and attack increase to make characters deliver and receive damage better. Along with Arle, other characters can join your party, for a maximum of 3 characters at a time. In addition, this game features over 60 side quests with NPCs that will reward the player if completed.

The game also features different multiplayer mode, a total of 17 from Puyo Puyo! 15th Anniversary and Puyo Puyo!! 20th Anniversary, and a new mode called Skill Battle.

153521.overview: Photos with Pikmin also known as Isshoni Photo Pikmin in Japan, is a Miscellaneous Application game developed and published by Nintendo for the Nintendo 3DS. It was released exclusively in Japan on December 02, 2013. The game can be considered an extension to the character viewing feature of AR Games, but dedicated to the Pikmin series.

153579.overview:
Pippi Longstocking for 3DS is a 3d Puzzle/Adventure game based on Astrid Lindgrens wonderful stories about the strongest girl in the world Pippi Longstocking. In the game the player gets the opportunity to meet and help well-known characters, solve problems in Pippis own way and play together with friends in new and exciting adventures. The art style in the game is a digital interpretation of the classical illustrations by Ingrid Nyman.

Join Pippi and her friends in an all new adventure!

154728.overview: Pika Pika Nurse Monogatari – Shounika wa itsumo Oosawagi is a Simulation game developed and published by Nippon Columbia for the Nintendo 3DS. It was released exclusively in Japan on November 10, 2016. It is part of the Akogare Girls Collection series, which offers life simulation experiences tailored for a younger audience. In this installment, players take on the role of a pediatric nurse working in a bustling children’s hospital. The game emphasizes daily nursing duties, including caring for young patients, assisting in medical procedures, and managing various hospital tasks. Through interactive mini-games and scenarios, players experience the challenges and rewards of pediatric nursing.​

154729.overview:
Pika Pika Nurse Monogatari 2 is a Strategy game developed and published by Nippon Columbia for the Nintendo 3DS. It was released exclusively in Japan on November 22, 2012. In Pika Pika Nurse Monogatari 2, players assume the role of a newly minted nurse starting her career at a bustling hospital. The game emphasizes daily nursing duties, including patient care, assisting in medical procedures, and managing various hospital tasks. Through interactive mini-games and scenarios, players experience the challenges and rewards of the nursing profession. ​

Players can personalize their nurse avatar by selecting facial features, hairstyles, eye colors, and outfits, allowing for a unique in-game identity. Engage with a diverse cast of hospital staff and patients, building relationships and navigating workplace dynamics. Participate in various mini-games that simulate nursing tasks, such as administering injections, monitoring vital signs, and caring for infants. As players successfully complete tasks and challenges, they unlock new areas of the hospital, additional responsibilities, and further customization options.

154788.overview:
A soccer game. In comparison to its predecessor, the biggest change is of technical nature: a completely different engine. This mostly has an effect on graphics, animations and physics and allows to initiate body movements like pushing. The playing speed is slower than in the previous installment and there are few smaller adjustments to the controls, e.g. optional guides during standard situations, a new system for penalties and the option to set and activate tactical predefined combinations for up to three playing field zones.

There are no major changes regarding playing modes, the player still can participate in different matches, competitions and leagues. The two major modes are Master League, in which the player takes on some managerial responsibilities like hiring new athletes (new: the player can change the club or manage national teams), and Become A Legend, in which the player accompanies a single athlete over his career (new: the option to become a goal keeper).
Groups +

154789.overview: World Soccer Winning Eleven 2014: Aoki Samurai no Chousen is a soccer game, developed and published by Konami, which was released in Japan in 2014.

154881.overview: Poyopoyo revolves around a spherical orange cat named Poyo, and the family that adopts him. The slice of life stories only have very mild continuity between them, and can be taken as stand-alone episodes. Episodes often deal with regular day-to-day interactions between family members, occasionally showing how family members celebrate holidays or deal with everyday inconveniences like rainstorms. At first, younger brother Hide dislikes Poyo, but as the stories continue, we see that Hide has grown somewhat attached to the family pet.

154892.overview: Pro Baseball Famista 2011 is a baseball game developed by Namco Bandai Games for the Nintendo 3DS. It is from a series of baseball video games called Famista. The games are solely in Japan. The first game was released December 10, 1986.

154893.overview:
Pro Yakyū: Famista Climax is a baseball game for the Nintendo 3DS, as a part of the Famista series of games by Bandai Namco. It was released in April 2017. The game also included a download code for Famista Retro developed by ITL, a Famicom-style game with data from the 2017 season.

Like the previous entries, Climax is a arcade-like baseball experience based on the real baseball teams of Japan. This entry adds the Japan Women's Baseball League. The mascots of the various baseball teams are also playable. Players can compete online using the teams they've trained.

In Dream Pennant mode, the player travels along game boards upgrading their stats or facing off against opposing teams depending on the space they land.

In Famista Quest mode, the player competes in various minigames across Japan, collecting baseball players as they go along.

Players can also create their own stadium, shifting around the stands and adding various hazards and changing the terrain of parts of the outfield.

154894.overview:
Pro Yakyuu Famista Returns is a Sports game developed by Eighting for the Nintendo 3DS. It was released exclusively in Japan on October 08, 2015. Pro Yakyuu Famista Returns serves as a sequel to Pro Yakyuu Famista 2011 and continues the long-running Famista (Family Stadium) series. This installment introduces several new features and game modes, enhancing the arcade-style baseball experience. Pro Yakyuu Famista Returns offers a blend of arcade-style and simulation baseball gameplay. It includes 3 game modes:​ Dream Pennant Mode – The main campaign mode when the player generates a team by using Famista Points from winning matches on various player cards.

Allows players to create and manage their own dream team, competing in a pennant race. This mode emphasizes team customization and strategy. Famista Quest – Using Ghost data from other players, the player journeys through Japan to save it from mysterious metallic aliens who are manipulating players. Beating players will let them join your team. Famista Rank Match – This is the online mode with matchmaking based on rank. Pro Yakyuu Famista Returns features all 12 Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) teams with updated rosters, as well as the inclusion of the Namco Stars team, comprising characters from various Namco franchises. ​

154908.overview: Penguin no Mondai – The Wars is an Adventure game developed and published by Konami for the Nintendo 3DS. It was released exclusively in Japan on December 15, 2011. The game is based on the popular Japanese manga and anime series Penguin no Mondai, known for its comedic and action-packed storytelling. In Penguin no Mondai: The Wars, players assume the role of a penguin commander embroiled in a whimsical conflict between rival factions. The game blends adventure and strategy elements, allowing players to explore various eras—past, present, and future—to collect characters and items unique to each time period. These collected elements can be used to build and customize a personal world, enhancing the game’s replayability and depth. ​

154909.overview: Penguin no Mondai Bakushou! Roulette Battle!! is a Nintendo 3DS action game developed and published by Alchemist that was released in Japan on April 10, 2014, for the Nintendo 3DS. This game is part of the Penguin no Mondai series and requires a Japanese Nintendo 3DS system to play. It is an action game with gameplay involving "roulette battles" and a focus on the penguin characters from the series.

154910.overview: Pom Pom Purin: Korokoro Daibouken is an Action game, developed and published by Rocket Company, which was released in Japan in 2016.

154935.overview: Zyuden Sentai Kyoryuger: Game de Gaburincho! ( 獣電戦隊キョウリュウジャー：ゲームでガブリンチョ！！ Juuden Sentai Kyouryuuja: Ge'mu de Gaburincho!!?) is a game developed by SeventhChord and published by Bandai Namco Games for the 3DS in 2013. It is based on the 37th season of the Super Sentai franchise, which was adapted by Saban Brands in 2015 as Power Rangers Dino Charge and Dino Super Charge. Despite the series being popular enough in South Korea to warrant a sequel series collaboration with Daewon Media titled Power Rangers Dino Force Brave, the 3DS game remained Japan-exclusive.

165815.overview: The story of the game focuses on the cast from Persona 3, Persona 4, and Persona 5. During a trip to Mementos, Joker and the rest of the Phantom Thieves of Hearts find themselves in a film, which is connected to a theater that is locked from the inside. With Makoto and Haru kidnapped, the Phantom Thieves meet Nagi and Hikari in the theater, who are also locked in with them, as well as Doe, a Shadow in the projection room. As the Phantom Thieves venture through movies, they meet allies along the way: the Persona 3 female protagonist in Kamoshidaman; the Investigation Team in Junessic Land; and SEES in A.I.G.I.S, all of them who have fallen into the movie world during a routine trip to the TV World and Tartarus.

171557.overview:
Punch Club is a Simulation Sports game developed by Lazy Bear Games for the Nintendo 3DS and was released on January 19, 2017. Punch Club is a sporting management simulation in which the player manages an upcoming boxer in training and preparation for a series of boxing matches at a local club while searching for clues about who killed their father. The game was developed as a humorous take on action films of the 1980s and 1990s.

The player controls an unnamed boxer whose father, who helped to train him, was murdered. The boxer aims to continue his training and become the best boxer at a local league while following clues to lead him to who killed his father. The player manages the boxer around the clock through various locations in a city, including his home, the boxing gym, stores, and his workplace. Time progresses when the player is involved in any activity, including moving between these locations.

173666.overview:
Watch the colorful antics of Pikmin™ as they jump into three short movies, the first movies ever directed by Shigeru Miyamoto. The three shorts, titled The Night Juicer, Treasure in a Bottle and Occupational Hazards find Pikmin in unusual, funny, and even dangerous situations. NOTE: No real Pikmin were harmed during the filming of these movies.

- Watch the colorful antics of Pikmin™ as they jump into three short movies: “The Night Juicer,” “Treasure in a Bottle,” and “Occupational Hazards”
- View bonus animated storyboards created by Shigeru Miyamoto using the Flipnote Studio™ software
- Own the Pikmin short movies that debuted at the 2014 Tokyo International Film Festival

174940.overview: Pyramids is a puzzle-platformer similar to Solomon's Key. The player must reach the the exit of each level by collecting the key, which they can reach by producing and removing blocks to walk on. They can also collect gold coins and other treasure to increase their score for each level. Hazards include spikes on the floor, flame and snakes, which the player can shoot at once they have collected bullets, and they can also use TNT where it is place in a level. There are 54 levels in total.

178520.overview: PachiPara 3D: Ooumi Monogatari 2 with Agnes Lum - Pachi-Pro Fuuunroku Hana Kesareta License is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by Irem, which was released in Japan in 2012.

178521.overview: PachiPara 3D – Ooumi Monogatari 2 – Pachi Pro Fuuunroku Hana – Kibou to Uragiri no Gakuen Seikatsu is a Simulation game developed and published by Irem for the Nintendo 3DS. It was released exclusively in Japan on May 17, 2012. The game offers a 3D pachinko experience, featuring machines from the “Ooumi Monogatari 2” series. It utilizes stereoscopic 3D effects to replicate the physical pachinko machine’s visuals. The narrative follows a storyline set in a school environment, where themes of hope and betrayal unfold, adding an adventurous twist to the traditional pachinko gameplay. ​

178522.overview: PachiPara 3D: Premium Umi Monogatari - Yumemiru Otome to Pachinko Ou Ketteisen is a gambling game developed by Irem and was released for Nintendo 3DS on 11/24/2011

178524.overview:
Pictlogica Final Fantasy was a free-to-play action puzzle game developed by Jupiter for iOS and Android. A Nintendo 3DS Download-only version was announced and released in Japan on July 12, 2017, featuring new puzzles and a new game mode.

The 3DS version of the game includes over 300 completely revamped puzzles designed in nostalgic pixel art. Players are able to fight classic enemies in quest battles, and collect 160 beloved characters from the Final Fantasy series

185105.overview: Shuriken Sentai Ninninger: Game de Wasshoi!! is an Action game, developed and published by Bandai Namco Games, which was released in Japan in 2015.

195139.overview:
With enhanced color graphics and Pikachu by your side, Pokémon Yellow Version stays true to the original game released nearly 20 years ago. You'll feel like you're playing it just as it was, but you can trade and battle Pokémon using local wireless on the Nintendo 3DS family of systems! Revisit Pokémon Yellow Version or play it for the first time!

Experience one of the original adventures that began the Pokémon phenomenon, but now on the Nintendo 3DS family of systems! Set out on your adventure together with your friend Pikachu, complete with monochromatic pixel art, 4-bit background music and, for the first time in the series, enhanced color elements. You'll take on the role of a Pokémon Trainer and travel across the land searching for Pokémon with Pikachu. Catch, battle, and trade as you work to become the best Pokémon Trainer! If you want to catch all of the Pokémon, you'll need to trade wirelessly with your friends who have Pokémon Red or Pokémon Blue Version.

195601.overview: PachiPara 3D – Deluxe Umi Monogatari – Pachi-Pro Fuuunroko – Hana Kotou no Shoubushi Tachi is a Simulation game developed and published by Irem for the Nintendo 3DS. It was released exclusively in Japan on February 07, 2013. The game offers a 3D pachinko experience, featuring the popular “CR Deluxe Umi Monogatari” machine. It utilizes stereoscopic 3D effects to replicate the physical pachinko machine’s visuals. The narrative follows Sakura Noto, who, en route to the Pachinko World Cup, becomes stranded on a remote island with 13 other pachinko professionals. They encounter mysterious pachinko machines and a formidable giant creature, adding an adventurous twist to the traditional pachinko gameplay. ​

195609.overview: Pretty Rhythm: My * Deco Rainbow Wedding is an Action game, developed by syn Sophia and published by Takara Tomy, which was released in Japan in 2013.

195610.overview:
Pretty Rhythm – Rainbow Live – Kirakira My Design is a Rhythm game developed by Syn Sophia for the Nintendo 3DS. It was released exclusively in Japan on November 28, 2013. In Pretty Rhythm – Rainbow Live – Kirakira My Design, players assume the role of an aspiring “Prism Star,” aiming to captivate audiences through performances that blend fashion, dance, and ice skating. The core gameplay revolves around rhythm-based mini-games where timing and coordination are key to delivering successful shows.

A unique feature of the game is the “My☆Design” system, allowing players to customize outfits and accessories, enhancing performance aesthetics. ​The game features characters from the Pretty Rhythm: Rainbow Live anime series, including Naru Ayase, Ann Fukuhara, and Ito Suzuno. It also introduces a new character, Cosmo Hojo, who was later integrated into the anime. Additionally, characters from previous series entries, such as Aurora Dream and Dear My Future, make appearances, enriching the game’s narrative and appeal. ​

195612.overview:
PriPara & Pretty Rhythm – PriPara de Tsukaeru Oshare Item 1450! is a Rhythm game developed by Syn Sophia for the Nintendo 3DS. It was released exclusively in Japan on March 19, 2015. PriPara & Pretty Rhythm – PriPara de Tsukaeru Oshare Item 1450! serves as an enhanced version of Pretty Rhythm: Rainbow Live – Kirakira My☆Design, integrating elements from both the Pretty Rhythm and PriPara franchises.

PriPara & Pretty Rhythm – PriPara de Tsukaeru Oshare Item 1450! combines rhythm-based performances with extensive fashion customization. Players can engage in musical mini-games, dressing up characters in various outfits—known as “coords”—to enhance their stage presence. The game boasts a collection of approximately 1,450 fashion items, allowing for a vast array of style combinations. ​

195614.overview:
Puzzle & Dragons X – Kami no Shou also known as Puzzle & Dragons X is a Puzzle RPG game developed by GungHo for the Nintendo 3DS. It was released exclusively in Japan on July 28, 2016. Puzzle & Dragons X is a spinoff of the mobile game Puzzle & Dragons and it was released in two versions simultaneously on July 28, 2016; the Gods Chapter (Puzzle & Dragons X: Kami no Shou) and the Dragons Chapter (Puzzle & Dragons X: Ryuu no Shou). Puzzle & Dragons is a match-three puzzle game, requiring players to move and match coloured orbs arranged in a grid.

The amount and type of matches determine which of the six monsters on the player’s team attack the waves of enemy monsters and how much damage they do. An additional layer of challenge is the acquisition, selection, and improvement of a team of monsters from among thousands ranging from standard fantasy fare to deities from several religions and mythologies and characters from popular entertainment franchises. The story takes place in a fantasy world inhabited by humans, dragonoids, and monsters, who live in relative harmony.

There are also Drops and spherical objects from the planet which can power up Monsters. Humans and dragonoids can become Dragon Callers if they have the ability to see the Drops, which allows them to form bonds with Monsters. Currently, the planet is experiencing Drop Impacts, phenomena where a large number of Drops are suddenly generated in a single area and can spread, affecting the area and causing Monsters to go berserk. One of the main duties of Dragon Callers is to stop Drop Impacts by stabilizing the Drop distribution.

195615.overview: Dragons X Ryu no Shou Nintendo 3DS ...Puzzle & Dragons X: Ryuu no Shou is a Nintendo 3DS title in the Puzzle & Dragons franchise, released in Japan in 2016. It's the "Dragon Chapter" version of the Pazudora Kurosu series, a puzzle RPG where players match orbs to battle monsters and collect them using a "Capture Mode". The game features a Pokemon-like capture mechanic, Soul Armor customization, and a story about becoming a Dragon Summoner.

195622.overview: In Puzzle & Dragons Z, the player takes the role of a prospective young Dragon Tamer in Zed City of the Dracomacia continent. The game begins on the day the player is to take an exam in order to become a Dragon Tamer; the player follows two of their friends — another prospective Dragon Tamer, Nick, and an established Dragon Tamer, Sara — to Zed City's Ranger HQ, where Dragon Tamers are issued commands and study monsters, and where the Dragon Tamer test is administered. The player, alongside Nick, receives a "D-Gear", an item which allows them to digitally store monsters, and afterwards is allowed to hatch Eggs containing their first three monsters.

197999.overview: Unleash your inner fashion designer with the pre-owned Pripara Mezameyo! Megami No Dress Design 3Ds from Japan Figure! This engaging game lets you create stunning outfits and rule the Pripara stage. Experience the thrill of designing unique dresses and becoming the ultimate idol.

198000.overview:
PriPara Aim! Idol ☆ Grand Prix No.1! is a PriPara 3DS video game produced and made by Takara Tomy A.R.T.S.

It was released on October 22nd, 2015 for retail or download.

The game features graphics and gameplay similar to the arcade game.

198001.overview:
PriPri Chi-chan! also known as PriPri Chi-chan! PriPri DecoRoom! is a Simulation game developed and published by Konami for the Nintendo 3DS. It was released exclusively in Japan on November 16, 2017. PriPri Chi-chan! is based on the manga and anime series PriPri Chi-chan!! by Hiromu Shinozuka. This series began in Shogakukan’s Ciao magazine in April 2015 and was adapted into an anime by OLM, Inc., which aired from April to December 2017.​

In PriPri Chi-chan! PriPri DecoRoom!, players engage in a virtual career simulation where they design and decorate rooms. The game emphasizes creativity, allowing players to customize spaces with various furniture and decorative items. While specific gameplay mechanics are not extensively documented, the game aligns with the simulation genre’s typical features, focusing on design and customization elements.​

200414.overview:
Psycho Pigs is a arena based bombing action game remake of the 1987 classic Jaleco game!

There are a wide variety of bombs and power up items that you can use to ham it up!

'Hit and don't get hit' is the aim of the game so use the arena's properties to your advantage, such as hiding in the bushes to sneak up on your foes.



You can play versus up to 4 players in local or online action!

Cooperative play is possible with 2 players in local and online.

A tournament is also available to test your skills!

Collect the various customizations and development materials!

200647.overview:
Eternal X & Wilting Y are typical difficulty/721 hacks; all Pokémon are obtainable in all versions of the games, trade evolutions are optional and they are, of course, more difficult than the base games. The Rebalanced Version includes all of these changes, as well as many base stat, type and movepool changes intended to make weaker Pokémon more fun to use. And if you thought the Elite Four was a challenge before, brace yourself – they’re now at Level 100! But don’t worry, there’s no need to grind endlessly to match their prowess.

TRAINER TRANSFORMATION
The trainers in Pokémon Supernova Sun have undergone a complete makeover. The game’s challenge is amplified with every trainer being edited. The EXP Share feature ensures rapid leveling up, making disabling it a risky move. From the Captains to the Kahunas, bosses now boast six Pokémon each. And guess what? Every non-Legendary Pokémon will make an appearance in a trainer’s team during the main story. Talk about a comprehensive Pokémon experience!

WILD POKÉMON REVAMP
Pokémon Supernova Sun offers four distinct builds, each altering wild Pokémon availability. The most popular? The Expanded Build. It boosts the variety of Pokémon in Alola, ensuring players encounter 58% of non-Legendary evolution lines on Melemele Island alone! By Ula’ula Island, this number jumps to a whopping 98%. And for those concerned about legitimacy, the Legit Build ensures all wild Pokémon are 100% legit for trades.

POKÉMON TWEAKS: STAYING LEGIT
While the game introduces several tweaks, it doesn’t break any rules. Pokémon maintain their intercompatibility with Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon. Level-up learnsets have been enhanced, providing better access to moves. And the best part? No illegal moves have been added, ensuring a fair play experience.

ITEM INNOVATIONS
Pokémon Supernova Sun introduces the Restoration Wing, a new item available in Poké Marts. It fully restores a Pokémon’s HP and status but remains unusable during battles. And for those who remember the Sacred Ash, it’s now the “Revival Powder”, acting as a Max Revive for your entire party. Plus, with Max Repel’s duration increased by 50%, wandering through tall grass has never been more convenient!

POKÉ MART MAKEOVER
Gone are the days of redundant items in Poké Marts. Now, players can find competitive items like Focus Sash and Weakness Policy replacing the old Antidote and Paralyze Heal. And if you’re looking for a bargain, all Poké Balls and Repels are on sale! From the Thrifty Megamart to Route 5’s Pokémon Center, each mart offers unique items to enhance your gameplay.

EVOLUTION EXTRAVAGANZA
Pokémon Supernova Sun introduces alternate evolution methods. Whether it’s trade evolutions or version-based evolutions, players now have more flexibility in evolving their Pokémon. For instance, Eevee now uses a Stone for all its evolutions, and Pokémon that traditionally evolved in specific areas have alternate methods.

Pic-a-Pix are sometimes known by other names, such as Picross, Nonogram, Paint by Numbers, Griddlers, Hanjie and many more.

Pic-a-Pix Color adds a new dimension to this popular puzzle by using colored clues to indicate which color each block should be painted. The new rules add a unique twist to the game's logic and the puzzles produce beautiful, colorful pixel art.
